faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Chandigarh (DLSA Chandigarh) for contractual positions under the Legal Aid Defense Counsel System.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post notified?
faq.answer: The notified post is Office Assistant/Clerk under the DLSA Chandigarh recruitment drive bearing advertisement number No.SLSA-UT/2025(LADCS)/2026/4284.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Office Assistant/Clerk position under this notification issued by DLSA Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 30 October 2026 up to 05:00 p.m. at the designated office address in Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted in offline mode by hand to the office of the Chief Judicial Magistrate-cum-Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree along with basic word processing skills, good typing speed, ability to take dictation, and file maintenance knowledge.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Office Assistant/Clerk post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of RS. 22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates applying for this recruitment according to the official notification details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening followed by engagement based on the requisite qualifications and specific operational requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with required documents should be submitted at the Office of Chief Judicial Magistrate-cum-Secretary, DLSA, Sector-43, Chandigarh.
